events.name: Minnesota Wild at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Kirill Kaprizov completed the sixth hat trick of his NHL career on the power play with 1:51 remaining to lead the Minnesota Wild to a 5-4 win over the Detroit Red Wings on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kirill Kaprizov has a hat trick as the Wild bounce back to beat the Red Wings 5-4

headlines.description: — Rickard Rakell scored twice, Sidney Crosby had a goal and two assists and the Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Florida Panthers 5-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rakell scores twice, Crosby has a goal and two assists as the Penguins beat the Panthers 5-2

headlines.description: — Porter Martone capped a fantastic first week in the NHL with a power-play goal to put the Philadelphia Flyers even closer toward ending a miserable playoff drought with a 2-1 overtime victory over the Boston Bruins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Porter Martone’s OT power-play goal lifts Flyers past Bruins 2-1, keeps playoff push alive

headlines.description: — Brady Tkachuk scored twice and the Ottawa Senators beat the Carolina Hurricanes 6-3 on Sunday night to move into the second wild-card spot in the Eastern Conference.
headlines.shortLinkText: Senators beat the Hurricanes 6-3 to move into the second wild-card spot in the East

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Jacob Markstrom made 18 saves for his first shutout of the season and the New Jersey Devils beat Montreal 3-0 on Sunday night, ending the Canadiens' eight-game winning streak hours after they clinched a second straight playoff spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Devils beat Montreal 3-0, ending the playoffs-bound Canadiens' 8-game winning streak

headlines.shortLinkText: Capitals get blown out 8-1 by the Rangers in a game crucial to their playoff hopes
